title: narcissus neglectus subsp. biancae
intro: Narcissus neglectus subsp. biancae, commonly known as the Bianca daffodil or Bianca narcissus, is a rare and lesser-known subspecies of the Narcissus neglectus plant, characterized by its white, trumpet-shaped flowers. It has been reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate the nervous system, promote relaxation, and exhibit sedative effects. Bioactive constituents of Narcissus neglectus subsp. biancae include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
